nora-sales: Heads-up from CapitalOne-like client: 10-day EU-only POC. Must provide signed subprocessors list, routing-path statement for auditors, BYO-KMS pricing, and a quick hosted vs dedicated cost note. Can presales assemble?
ev an-se: Quick clarifiers: model (family), expected sustained RPS, and is BYO-KMS required for the POC or only for production?
nora-sales: They're validating rwd-medium, ~30 RPS sustained with bursts to 120 for imports. BYO-KMS optional for POC but must be in the quote. Auditor wants an ops statement showing no cross-border hops.
priya-ops: We can pin tenants to EU regions (eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1). Standard subproc list: AWS (EC2,S3), Cloudflare (CDN), Sentry, Datadog, HashiCorp (Vault). I'll export the inventory and include SOC2/ISO links.
priya-ops: Sample enforcement config we can share: ```json {"tenant":"capone-poc","region_pin":"eu-central-1","geofence":true,"fallback":"disabled"} ```
ev an-se: For the auditor, we can also provide a simple network flow statement: "Control-plane and inference payloads for a pinned tenant remain in the selected EU region; no egress to non-EU regions is performed." Legal needs to sign.
sam-legal: I'll take the attestation once Sales/Ops drop the subproc CSV + routing statement. Also need liability & BYO-KMS bullet points for the quote.
nora-sales: Action items: (1) priya-ops -> upload subproc export + cert links + short network diagram; (2) evan-se -> add BYO-KMS line to POC quote and egress delta (hosted vs dedicated); (3) sam-legal -> attestation draft when artifacts available; (4) nora-sales -> schedule kickoff after attestation. ETA 36-48h.
infra-bot: artifact note: capone-poc-config v1 uploaded to staging at 2024-02-20T11:02Z

nora-sales: Great, thanks all — holding customer call until attestation is in review. :pray:
